blacken_rule: Training photos only: every pixel whose 3-class label is 'Other' is set to black (0, 0, 0); padding and target pixels are unchanged. Undersampling as in the undersampling pipeline with the ratio chosen there (per budget and model family). Validation and test photos are real and unmodified.
label: Undersampling pipeline

ratio.based_on: validation only (test split sealed until the study freeze)
ratio.rule: For each budget and model family (U-Net decides for the U-Net + CRF; the RF decides for itself): the ratio with the highest mean validation flooded mIoU over the 3 seeds; ties go to the smaller ratio. Only the chosen ratio's runs are scored on the test split.

rule: Keep every flooded-building and flooded-road pixel (U-Net) or region (RF). Keep 'Other' at r times the number of target pixels/regions of the budget's training set: the U-Net keeps each 'Other' pixel with probability min(1, r * target_pixels / other_pixels) from a fixed, seeded draw per image (the same subset every epoch; dropped pixels are ignored by the loss, the photo is unchanged); the RF keeps a seeded random sample of min(#other, round(r * #target)) 'Other' regions. No class weights. The U-Net + CRF applies the frozen CRF setting to each undersampled U-Net.

timing.boundary: Processed RGB already in host RAM -> CPU pixel prediction. Original decoding excluded; RF includes fresh SLIC/features; U-Net includes normalisation/transfers/argmax.
